_description: Web page zone: embeds a URL in a dashboard tile (Tableau Cloud accepted this exact shape)

zone._placement: Inside a dashboard's layout zone, alongside the worksheet zones

notes.no_name: A web zone has no name attribute; it doesn't reference a worksheet.
notes.embeddable_urls: The site must allow framing. For YouTube use the /embed/<id> URL; a /watch?v= URL is refused inside the iframe.
notes.zone_id: The id must be unique across every dashboard in the workbook.
notes.static_render: get-view-image renders web zones blank. Check them in the live view, and give the iframe a few seconds to load before deciding it's empty.
notes.dashboard_datasources: As with any dashboard, keep the dashboard's empty <datasources /> element; Tableau Cloud rejects a dashboard without it.
